scope: Three source root causes only; generated artifacts and unrelated working-tree changes left alone. No rule suppressions.

rootCauses.name: External-script status listener ownership
rootCauses.impact: Low-severity lifecycle hardening. The existing one-shot recorder intentionally survives component unmount so late script success or failure is available to later consumers. There was no explicit release when a pending script was removed; no production memory leak was established. Blind unmount cleanup would break late-load behavior.
rootCauses.fix: Transfer recording to a document-scoped owner. Deduplicate per script, release both listeners on load/error or DOM removal, disconnect the removal observer when no scripts remain. The upstream hook still removes component state listeners on unmount.
rootCauses.tests: Existing sharing, Strict Mode, late success, HubSpot/chat and server-render tests preserved. Added removed-pending-script and late-error/remount tests. Removed-script regression failed before the fix.

rootCauses.name: Standalone-card child identity
rootCauses.impact: User-visible data loss: a parent rerender replaced card children, clearing uncontrolled input and focus. Reproduced for both linked and unlinked cards.
rootCauses.fix: Hoist ActionArea to module scope and pass link props explicitly, preserving link behavior and styling.
rootCauses.tests: Both input identity/value/focus regressions failed before the fix and pass afterward; linked href remains unchanged.

rootCauses.name: Google-form option mutation
rootCauses.impact: Conditional form-render failure with read-only options; rendering also performed an in-place operation on shared input data. No live production failure observed.
rootCauses.fix: Copy the option array before sorting at both call sites. Preserve the existing comparator, choice ordering, blank select label, and checkbox blank filtering.
rootCauses.tests: Dropdown, radio and checkbox rendering from frozen arrays failed before the fix and now passes with unchanged source data and expected output.

recipeReview: Fetched canonical recipes with no-cache curl. Explicit external resource ownership, hoisted component identity, and copy-before-sort fixes match the recipes; no blanket listener removal or memoized nested component workaround.
grouping: Three independent root causes cover five diagnostics: one listener ownership finding, two rules for the same card component, and two option-mutation sites. Selected baseline diagnostics have no fixGroupId.

validation.eslint: All 7 touched source/test files pass without warnings or errors
validation.build: No production build performed; generated artifacts intentionally left untouched.

followUp: SectionParallax key spread and tracking-pixel alternate text remain the two source errors.
Other nested-component wrappers, unchecked fetch responses, state synchronization and complexity findings remain for later passes.
